purpose: Claim policy for evidence bundles. Extends the claim policy of the Phase 3 closure record with statements that cite events the driver-to-event linkage record ties to graph edges. Read by ehr_evidence_app.evidence.policy, which refuses to run unless these values equal the ones it implements.
conditions: History statements about a driver's concept cite linked events in pre-target visits only.
A score is never assigned to, divided across or tied to an event, a date or a visit.
Final-admission drug and procedure records are described only as final-admission context, never as history.
Final-admission diagnoses never enter an explanation.
